name: All seven audio files decode as real audio
Seven physical shortcut keys hit the matching pad
Holding a key does not repeat a hit
Typing in notes does not trigger pads
Shortcut toggle disables keys while mouse clicks still play
Pad activation turns off after feedback interval

Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Space work with visible focus and allow exit
